metaTitle: Do Sleeping Bag Liners Add Warmth?
description: Sleeping bag liners add roughly 3 to 15 degrees depending on material. Compare silk, cotton, fleece and thermal liners and when a liner is worth it.
directAnswer: Yes, modestly: silk and cotton add about 3 to 8 degrees, fleece and thermal liners up to roughly 15. Liners also keep a bag clean and add comfort, but they will not turn a summer bag into a winter one.
